quotes.text: Save the on-disk local name before currentFolderNameStr gets modified.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: An old .msf file predicate stripped the suffix from its input by reference. Later cleanup could then delete the mbox data file instead of the index file. Keep the actual file path separate from the derived folder name during IMAP subfolder discovery.
title: Do not let a file-filter predicate mutate an IMAP folder path
